description: Moon in houses 1-12 from Vol II, paraphrased. Same row schema as planet_house.json.

rows.theme: Like pure milk; wealth and honour tied to the mother's blessing.

conditions.effect: Respecting the mother brings long life and plenty; dutiful service to relatives and guests builds wealth.
Friendly planets in H4 and H10 give profitable journeys, especially by sea; benefic planets in H7 and H8 make one very wealthy.
Jupiter in H4 with Saturn in H10 adds comforts, conveyance and wealth.
Venus in H7 gives a good home; Mercury in H7 with no malefic aspect gives wealth through voyages.
Loss of honour through deceit or evil deeds; selling milk is unlucky; a spouse stays unhappy whatever Venus does.
Saturn or Sun in H2 or H6 brings poverty; Jupiter in H11 gives a troubled, unhappy life.
Marrying before about 28 can harm the mother and her side.
A soldered silver vessel or much green (Mercury) material can harm health, especially the mother's eyes.

remedies.text: Use silver vessels for milk and drink water from a silver glass; avoid plain glass.
Water a peepal or banyan tree now and then; fit four copper nails to the bed legs.
Bury items of Mars (red, copper) outside the house; deal in red goods and round silver utensils instead of milk trade.
When travelling more than about 100 days, drop a copper coin in running water.
If H7 is empty, marry before 24 or keep a maid or cow at home; keep a dog after marriage for children's welfare.

rows.note: Dormant/awakening ages and annual-chart ages in footnotes not captured. Animal-keeping remedies kept only as non-harmful care.

rows.theme: Self-earned wealth; blessing holds while Moon items stay at home.

conditions.effect: Mother lives long (to about the native's 48th year) when Rahu, Ketu and Saturn avoid H4, 6, 9, 10, 12.
Moon here gives the good results of Jupiter wherever Jupiter sits; keeping rice and silver at home brings ancestral property.
Moon passing through H1 in transit cleans the chart's poison; those years (2,14,26,38,50,62...) are lucky.
Strong benefic Venus gives good in-laws and success in love.
Temple bells rung in the house are said to cost the native children.
Sun in H1, Saturn in H10, Jupiter in H11, Ketu in H12 or Mercury in H6 bring trouble: poor eyesight, hard old age, a choice between education and children.
Rahu, Ketu or Saturn in H9, 10 or 12 puts the mother's health at risk around ages 9, 18, 36.

remedies.text: Give green cloth to young girls for 40 or 43 days to wash off Mercury's poison.
Embed silver foil in the foundation of the bed.
Keep the house floor kuchcha (unpaved), serve elders, donate rice and silver through the mother.
Take some silver from the mother when leaving on a journey; bury silver in the foundation of a self-built house or flow it in water.

rows.note: Benefic condition about strong Venus is not tied to a house in the source. Keeping a horse omitted as impractical.

rows.theme: Protector against theft and untimely death; wealth if brothers and sisters are cared for.

conditions.effect: Wealth is unbounded if one looks after brothers and sisters; with H9 and H11 empty there is no harm from the Moon.
A strong Mercury and a living Moon give a pious, brave, victorious life with no theft; Venus and Mars give their own good results.
Sun in H1, Saturn in H11, Mercury in H5 and Jupiter in H9 together form a royal combination with ancestral gain.
Favourable years come every third day, month or year; one parent stays alive to support.
A malefic lord of the 8th, or the 8th year, brings loss of wealth; Mars polluted by Saturn leads to downfall.
Mars or Mercury with Mars in H10 makes Mars items unfavourable to mother and brother, giving separation or jealousy; H3 then acts like Moon in H11.

remedies.text: Serve every guest at least milk or water.
At a daughter's birth donate Moon items (milk, rice, silver); at a son's birth donate Sun items (jaggery, wheat, not glittering).
Propitiate Mercury (green cloth to girls).

rows.note: Remedy of marrying off a daughter to ward off calamity omitted (coercive); birth-donation remedies paraphrased loosely.

rows.theme: As one spends, wealth grows; milk and charity are auspicious.

conditions.effect: Alone in H4, wealth keeps coming despite spending; the mother is favourable and work with her help does well.
Jupiter or Sun in H5 brings wealth from the birth of a son; Jupiter in H2 or 9 with Sun in H5 forms a royal combination.
Moon with three other planets gives fourfold wealth.
Saturn in H9 or H11 makes one gentle and a jewel of the family; Jupiter in H6 gives ancestral property.
Selling milk is unfavourable; Rahu in H10 gives head injury and troubles Mercury matters.
Jupiter in H10 may bring a false accusation and imprisonment; Jupiter with Ketu in H2 needs a religious remedy.
Moon conjoined with exactly two other planets makes all three malefic.

remedies.text: Donate milk instead of selling it.
Keep a jug of milk beside you when starting a task.
Grandfather and grandson visiting a holy place together, or a havan, to wash away Jupiter-Ketu evils.

rows.theme: Mother's milk, a spiritual river; long life and brave, but sharp-tempered.

conditions.effect: Wealthy, charitable and respected, with about 100 years of life; building wells or hand pumps for the public blesses children.
Mercury in H7 or H11 helps; Ketu favourable (in H6) with H9 empty gives at least five sons; Rahu is dormant.
Greed, a loose tongue and keeping no secrets spoil the Moon; a rash, ruinous nature if some planet is in H10 or H12.
Saturn, Rahu or Ketu in H2/H3 or Sun with Mercury in H9/H11 leave Moon unfavourable.
Afflicted Mercury can bring a very short life in the worst cases.

remedies.text: Float rice and sugar cubes tied in a white cloth in flowing water on Mondays.
Eat something sweet and carry some when leaving for work.

rows.theme: Deceptive position, sour water; one gets back what one gives.

conditions.effect: Moon alone gives excellent youth and old age; enemies turn friends; Mercury in H2/H8 or Mars in H12 does not harm wealth.
Jupiter in H2 is favourable; a benefic H2/4/8/12 helps.
If H4, H8 and H12 are malefic, the Moon is malefic until about 34; weak Venus harms in-laws, Mercury the mother's side, Ketu the father's.
Boring a well at Moon ages (6,12,24) harms wealth and health; Sun in H12 risks eyesight.
Mars in H4 or H8 with Mercury in H8 may cost the mother early.

remedies.text: Donate Sun, Mars or Jupiter items (jaggery, wheat, copper, etc.) at a temple and worship there.
Take milk by day, not at night; do not donate milk.
Dig a well, if at all, at a hospital or cremation ground, not for travellers or farming.

rows.note: Remedy of giving water to a dying person for 6 days omitted (medical claim).

rows.theme: Mother of children; wealth like a goddess, wife brings abundance.

conditions.effect: Alone in H7 the Moon is a goddess of wealth; benefic Venus or Mercury with H8 empty gives wealth, family and domestic bliss.
Saturn in H3 or Jupiter in H7 keeps Moon from acting badly; very wealthy and respected if Rahu-Ketu are not malefic.
Marrying at 6, 12 or 24 makes Venus, Mercury and Rahu-Ketu negative; quarrelling with the mother brings ruin.
Selling milk or water means loss of wealth; Mercury goods are not profitable.
Venus or Mercury in H1 with Saturn linked, or Venus with Rahu-Ketu-Saturn, causes early deaths of children or loss of property.

remedies.text: Keep Moon items at home: silver, milk, river water.
Honour and obey the mother; do not sell milk or water.

rows.note: Source also mentions weapon death after long life; not stored.

rows.theme: Dead mother, burnt milk; service to elders brings long life.

conditions.effect: Jupiter and Saturn in H2 make Rahu and Mars helpful and the Moon fully alive.
Benefic Mercury or Sun or Venus gives about 80 years; mother's life protects the native.
Mercury in H2 with Jupiter in H9 or H12 gives parents long life.
If Venus or Mercury or Saturn is malefic, loss of wealth, in-laws and children and sudden attacks; a well near the ancestral house worsens it.
The 12th, 24th and 48th years are troublesome; mother's death possible at 4, 8, 24 when planets sit in H11 and H2 is empty.
Mercury in H4 or H12 or Saturn-Rahu in H12 harms eyesight; hard luck till 34.

remedies.text: Donate milk in the names of elders and take their blessings by touching their feet.
Wash the feet of children and elders for gain and success; do not enter the jewellery trade.
Establish Moon items (milk, wells) again and again for long life.

rows.note: Remedies on a nose piercing and well water from a funeral site omitted (body modification / unhygienic).

rows.theme: A potful of pearls; protector in adversity; nine times effective for progeny and wealth.

conditions.effect: Learned, religious, a good mathematician, pilgrim and helper of the poor.
Sun or Jupiter in H5 or friendly planets in H3 and H4 give wealth, children and comforts; Jupiter in H9 gives rank and conveyance.
Planets in H3 and H5 come under the Moon's control; even Rahu-Ketu-Saturn there do not damage H5.
Rahu malefic or linked gives results of companions; Ketu in H2 with Mercury in H5 clouds judgement and delays success to 34 or 48.
Venus in H3 can trouble the mother's eyes around 24 or 25.

remedies.text: Keep good company; serve the poor and the religious.

rows.theme: Poisonous water, useless milk: needs religion and clean conduct.

conditions.effect: Long life (about 90) for a religious person; blank H2 with a male planet in H4 helps, especially in surgery started at 24.
Sun, Jupiter or Mars in H4: very wealthy and comfortable.
Irreligious conduct or contact with the opposite sex brings ruin; Saturn in H1 or H4 gives gain by forgery or deceit.
Sun in H7 risks drowning by day; Rahu-Ketu-Saturn in H4 with Venus in H7 risks children's deaths.
A planet in H5 or H6 damages Moon items; blank H2 risks lung and chest disease.

remedies.text: Do not drink milk at night; use water from hand pump, well, river or canal for about ten years.
Doctors: do not treat at night or dilute medicines.
Take Jupiter's help (yellow items, guru's blessing).

rows.note: Several H10 clauses imply crime/cheating; only conduct-oriented guidance kept.

rows.theme: As good as zero; milk donation brings a surviving son.

conditions.effect: Jupiter or Saturn benefic, or Mercury in H5, brings wealth, children and long life; Sun and Mercury in H4 gives comforts and favour of authorities.
Ordinary results; Ketu wherever it sits is malefic, and a male child may not survive in the grandmother's sight.
Saturn or Ketu in H3 or weak H3 can bring the mother's ill health, or a troubled childhood.
Five day-based errors ruin the native, e.g. Mercury trade on Wednesday, Friday marriage, Saturday construction.

remedies.text: Donate milk at a temple (Bhairon temple in the text); feed milk to eleven persons.
Make 121 milk-sweet balls and distribute to children or float in a river.
Mother may wash head and eyes with milk.

rows.note: Remedies on separating mother and newborn for 43 days and a hot gold bar quenched in milk for virility omitted as harmful/unsafe.

rows.theme: River in spate: destroys inhabited areas; forgotten goals.

conditions.effect: Sun-Mercury in H3 salvage the clan; benefic Jupiter or Sun makes the Moon give milk instead of water.
When Moon transits H1 it salvages all fronts.
Ancestral property is lost though own earnings stay; gifts from parents are inauspicious.
Anxiety and discomfort at night; addiction risk; losses to in-laws when Moon returns to H1 (ages 12, 24, 35 ...).
Mars in H1 with Sun in H2 gives a poor unhappy life until 48; Sun in H6 risks an eye.
Rahu-Ketu-Saturn, Venus or Mercury in H2, H6, H12 bring destruction.

remedies.text: Do not drink water unless it is clean and potable.
Jupiter's help acts as a soothing balm (donate yellow items, serve gurus).

rows.note: Source ends with a Moon-in-12th table for Mars/Ketu/Mercury in H1-H12, not stored.
